integrity: The proof uses exact update identities and local asymptotic expansions. Numerical replay is supporting verification only, and unsuccessful literature searches are not treated as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local and restricted to the explicit quartic Rosenbrock family with curvature-matched short step.
The one-short-step threshold concerns attraction of the ravine-scaled normal coordinate and is not a global convergence classification.
A verified full PDF of arXiv:2604.13393 was unavailable; its abstract and publicly rendered figures were inspected, leaving a bounded literature-overlap risk.
title: A two-step Q-linear law and a sharp one-step normal threshold for GDPolyak on quartic Rosenbrock ravines
